blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Authorities arrested four people, including a woman, and seized at least P1 million worth of suspected shabu in a buy-bust operation in Barangay Rizal Poblacion, Banga, South Cotabato, on Saturday afternoon, Oct. 17. The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency-Region 12 (PDEA-12) identified the suspects as alias “Kim,” 26, and alias “Van,” 33, both residents of Barangay Rizal Poblacion; alias “Ar-Ar,” 21, of Barangay San Vicente; and alias “Mar,” 26, of Barangay Malaya. Authorities seized 151.8 grams of suspected shabu, or methamphetamine hydrochloride, worth P1,032,240, according to PDEA-12.
